Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Security Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Security Services provides comprehensive security solutions, including armed and unarmed security personnel, patrol services, event security management, and risk assessment for various clients, including commercial businesses, residential communities, and special events. Our team is trained to ensure the safety and security of properties and individuals while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer service. Additionally, we offer consulting services to enhance security measures tailored to our clients' unique needs.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft occurred at a client’s event where security personnel were stationed. The cause was determined to be a lack of adequate surveillance in the area, resulting in a loss of client property valued at $2,500. The claim has been reported and is currently under review with the insurance company.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour security patrols with motion-activated lighting and alarm systems, supplemented by monitored CCTV surveillance and regular safety audits.
